# 2014 Dow Corning Tennis Classic

The Dow Corning Tennis Classic was a professional women's tennis tournament held in **Midland, Michigan, USA**.

## Key Details

- **Category**: ITF Women's Circuit event ($50,000 prize money)
- **Surface**: Hard (indoor)
- **Date**: Typically held in late January/early February 2014

## Singles Champion

**Grace Min** of the United States won the singles title in 2014, which was a notable victory in her career on the ITF circuit.

## Doubles Champions

The doubles title was won by **Asia Muhammad** and **Maria Sanchez**, an American pairing.

## About the Tournament

The Dow Corning Tennis Classic was sponsored by Dow Corning Corporation (now part of Dow), which was headquartered in Midland. The tournament served as an important stepping stone for rising players on the professional circuit and was part of the ITF Women's World Tennis Tour.

The event was held at the Greater Midland Tennis Center and attracted emerging talent looking to earn ranking points and prize money on their way up the professional ranks.
